creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`cursor_position` (crates/muster-vt/src/replay.rs:278-284) restores a pending wrap by reprinting the cell. A blank cell formats to nothing, leaving `ESC 7`, `CSI 2 K`, `ESC 8`, so the wrap is lost. Upstream fixed its own version in #14670 and #14918. `GHOSTTY_FORMATTER_EXTRA_CURSOR` would cover it, but origin-relative positioning and right-margin wrap only fire with the modes extra on, and Muster states modes itself.

Found by reading; the move will not fix it. Add the blank-cell case, or have the carried state function in a_2vgzN6Tln set `cursor_origin` and `wrap_column`, about 10 lines, which also deletes `Region::parse`.
title: A replay loses a pending wrap when the cursor's cell is blank
